snippet.title: [$0.99→FREE] iOS Game "Fluffy Diver" Major Update!
snippet.description:
Fluffy Diver ( http://bit.ly/sLwJZS ) is have the plan for a major update(v1.5) in 14 June.

((((( Information for v1.5.0 Update )))))
- It is blitz mode for competition with friends. 
- Will be FREE change.($0.99 → Free+IAP)
- Retina display support! Finally!
- Sound change!
- And add various upgrade items!,
  Add new Character!(Parody character of A*gry Birds Sp*ce)
